answer: An agent network auditing a bridge at dawn or transcribing quill ledgers can deter Sybil attacks via Proof-of-Space-Time. Each identity must seal a unique, key-bound replica using a slow sequential encoding and answer periodic random Merkle challenges to remain registered. Because replicas cannot be deduplicated across keys, attackers incur dedicated storage capacity and sealing overhead per fake agent. Still, wealthy actors can lease bulk cloud disk to scale Sybils.
